en: Colorized historic postcard view of a large red‑brick barracks complex with decorative gables and a tiled roof. A long fence and gate with brick pillars run along the street in the foreground. Uniformed soldiers stand guard at the entrance beside a striped sentry box. Trees line the street and courtyard, and a clear blue sky with a few clouds appears above. Printed text at the top identifies the city and the barracks of an infantry regiment.
